It is not joined with the subjunctive unless a pronoun is placed before it, such as ὃς ἂν [whoever] and words derived from it, or a particle, such as ὅπως [in order that], εὖτε [when], ἕως [until], ἡνίκα [when], πρίν [before], ἔς τε [until], and it is never postponed after the subjunctive, but necessarily precedes it.

ἄν when placed without a verb refers to a verb to be repeated from the preceding words.
ἄν doubled
where I conjectured δή του [indeed]
Thus Hermann for οὐκ ἂν [not would] (or οὐκ ἄν γ᾽ [not would at least]) ἑλόντες ἂν [having taken would] (or α) θάνοιεν ἄν [they would die].
[But at line 418 τί δ᾽ ἂν φάντες τύχοιμεν ἄν [what would we achieve by saying?], Bothius rightly deleted the second ἂν.]
Concerning the placement of the particle, one passage must be noted
For thus Wellauer correctly wrote instead of δ᾽ ἄν [but would].
Faulty construction
where I restored πράσσοιμεν [we would do]
ἄν by crasis coalesces with the pronoun ἅ [which], contracted into ἅν, and with the particles καί [and] and τοί [indeed] into κἂν and τἄν, examples of which see under καί and τοι.

The conjunction wishes to cancel the actuality of the events, turning them into potentiality, whence it is also called 'potential'. For 'I wrote' or 'I was writing' or 'I had written' are either partially actualized or long since actualized; hence it attaches to those capable of receiving its material: 'I would be writing', 'I would have written', 'I would have written'; but not to 'I write' or 'I will write'; for it is not past, so that the cancellation of the actual by the conjunction and the promise of the future may be possible.
But if Justice had been present, this would quickly have happened.
But if he had died—three-bodied Geryon—he would have boasted of having taken a cloak.
But if not—the heart, anticipating, would have restrained the tongue from pouring out these words.
But if she had been—, this would rightly have been his.
If you had been slain—, you would have had a high-heaped tomb.
If you were armed with bows, I would have guessed very well.
For I would not have wished to see these things.
For this would have been a release from troubles.
For I would not have addressed you.
I, for my part, would have wished to become known to strangers.
Another would have come likewise to announce these things.
I would have prayed for the trampling of many garments.
Indeed, you would have been very much overlooking my oracles,
For who would have stopped the treacherous diseases of Hera?
You might speak.
You might be spoken of.
You might act now,
You might sleep.
You might mutter.
You might hear now.
You might boast of your lineage and speak further.
You might do.
You might go,
You would not be bearable, if you were doing well.
But if, which may it not happen, misfortune should befall, Eteocles alone would be sung of.
